atFfcMetrics.name: Front knee flexion at FFC
atFfcMetrics.interpretation: Knee bend is foreshortened from a front/back-on camera — value shown for reference; film side-on to assess a braced-knee landing.

atFfcMetrics.name: Head offset from front knee
atFfcMetrics.interpretation: 0 = perfectly over the knee; large |value| = falling away or chest-on.

atReleaseMetrics.name: Trunk lateral lean at release
atReleaseMetrics.interpretation: Big lateral lean (includes whole-body tilt). Lean of the trunk line from vertical in the image plane, for the selected camera angle (sideways lean for a front/back-on camera). The thorax–pelvis flexion is the injury-literature quantity and is still exploratory.

atReleaseMetrics.name: Thorax–pelvis lateral flexion at release
atReleaseMetrics.interpretation: Mid-range lateral lean (8–25°). Measured relative to the pelvis (lateral flexion). Angle between the shoulder line and the hip line in the image plane. Exploratory — the 2D hip line is not the pelvis segment a sensor measures; not yet validated against sensors.

atReleaseMetrics.name: Wrist height above head
atReleaseMetrics.interpretation: Positive = wrist above head (high release point).

atReleaseMetrics.name: Shoulder–hip separation
atReleaseMetrics.interpretation: Low separation — typical of front-on actions. Estimated from depth (approximate) — a front/back-on camera cannot see counter-rotation directly.

followThroughMetrics.name: Bowling-arm deceleration distance
followThroughMetrics.interpretation: Longer = smoother follow-through; very short = abrupt cut-off.
